posts.post: that feeling when you put on a piece you bought years ago and it still looks better than anything new in the store.
most people buy clothing that fits the version of themselves they want to be, not the one they actually are.
there is nothing more annoying than a shirt collar that loses its shape before you even finish lunch.

we removed the drawstrings from the new hoodies. 

they just got in the way every time we grabbed a coffee.
